description: Rothco’s Flyers Helmet Bag is the ultimate storage solution for active-duty personnel, motorcyclists, skaters, and bikers. Crafted from heavyweight denier polyester and featuring a padded interior, this bag ensures your helmet and accessories stay secure during transport. With dimensions of 19 inch x 19 inch, the carrying bag offers plenty of room for your aviation helmet. 2 hook and loop outside pockets, complemented by snap closures, provide additional storage for accessories and essential gear. The Flyers Helmet Bag is equipped with 2 sturdy top carry handles for convenient transportation, and a nylon zipper closure ensures easy access. Whether you're on duty or hitting the road, Rothco's Helmet Bag is your reliable companion for keeping your gear protected and organized.
